_meta.description: Audit-finding category templates for AuditorStatement findings. Categories follow Awb 4.2 + VNG grant-management guidance. Per-administration override allowed for categoryName/translations but not the severity mapping.

auditFindingTemplates.defaultRemediationTemplate: Verify the grantee and the funded activity meet all eligibility criteria stated in the beschikking (Awb 4:2). Provide supporting documentation within the remediation period.
Supply the missing or incomplete documentation (invoices, contracts, activity reports) supporting the grant expenditure.
Reconcile the reported expenditure against the general-ledger postings and demonstrate adequate internal financial controls.
Clarify the VAT/BTW treatment of the funded expenditure and confirm the grantee's tax registration status.
Address the identified non-compliance with the grant conditions or applicable regulation (SISA, Awb 4.2) before settlement can proceed.
Demonstrate that procurement for grant-funded activity followed the applicable aanbestedingsregels and provide the procurement audit trail.
Submit the outstanding accountability report or interim statement by the agreed deadline.
Address the auditor's note. See the attached comment for the specific remediation required.
